content: Our paper Dynamics-Predictive Sampling for Active RL Finetuning of Large Reasoning Models has been accepted to ICLR2026! Check out the full paper for more details!
Our paper Adaptive Neighborhood-Constrained Q Learning for Offline Reinforcement Learning has been accepted to NeurIPS2025 as Spotlight! Check out the full paper for more details!
Code for paper Can Prompt Difficulty be Online Predicted for Accelerating RL Finetuning of Reasoning Models? is now publicly available! Visit the GitHub repository to access it!

Our paper Can Prompt Difficulty be Online Predicted for Accelerating RL Finetuning of Reasoning Models? is made public! First trial to successfully predict the prompt difficulty online for RL finetuning of reasoning models, which can significantly accelerate the RL finetuning process. Check out the full paper for more details!

Our paper Fast and Robust: Task Sampling with Posterior and Diversity Synergies for Adaptive Decision-Makers in Randomized Environments has been accepted to ICML2025 with high scores (5443)! This work introduces PDTS to accommodate fast and robust sequential decision-making, unlocking the power of robust active task sampling.

Attention! Our paper Model Predictive Task Sampling for Efficient and Robust Adaptation is made public! First trial to successfully predict the optimization outcome after zero/few-shot adaptation given some tasks and model predictive task sampling (MPTS) significantly improves the adaptation robustness of multimodal foundation models and sequential decision-making with learning efficiency retained!
Latent Reward: LLM-Empowered Credit Assignment in Episodic Reinforcement Learning was accepted to AAAI2025. Congratulations to Yun Qu and Yuhang!
Robust Fast Adaptation from Adversarially Explicit Task Distribution Generation got accepted to KDD2025 Research Track, the literature work to generate task distributions for meta learning!

Doubly Mild Generalization for Offline Reinforcement Learning and Offline Reinforcement Learning with OOD State Correction and OOD Action Suppression got accepted to NeurIPS2024. Congratulations to Yixiu!
The multi-task learning SOTA work GO4Align: Group Optimization for Multi-Task Alignment got accepted to NeurIPS2024. Congratulations to Jiayi!
LLM-Empowered State Representation for Reinforcement Learning was accepted to ICML2024. Congratulations to Boyuan and Yun Qu!
